links.outcome: Gender fairness metrics and predictive performance in cardiac arrest outcome prediction after applying bias mitigation
links.effect: FairFML improved fairness metrics by up to 90% without compromising predictive performance.
links.quote: Validated through a real-world case study on reducing gender disparities in cardiac arrest outcome prediction, FairFML improved fairness metrics by up to 90% without compromising predictive performance.

unlisted_practices: Federated learning with fairness-aware training to build fair models across institutions while preserving patient privacy

screen.reason: Evaluates FairFML, a fairness-preserving and privacy-preserving federated learning framework designed to mitigate demographic bias across institutions, on a clinical predictive task.
